sentences.text: Today we will talk about a city in the United States of America.
This city is called Seattle.
Seattle is modern, green, rainy and very beautiful.
Part two, where is Seattle?
Seattle is in the northwest of the United States.
It is in the state of Washington.
The city is close to the ocean.
It is also close to big forests and tall mountains.
Part three, weather in Seattle.
Seattle is famous for its rain.
It rains many days of the year.
People often carry umbrellas.
Even with the rain, the city looks fresh and green.
Part four, the Space Needle Seattle has a very tall and famous tower called the Space Needle.
It looks like a tower from the future.
You can go up to the top.
From there, you can see the whole city and the mountains.
Part five, Pike Place Market.
One of the most popular places in Seattle is Pike Place Market.
It is a big colorful market.
You can buy fresh fish, fruit, flowers and handmade gifts.
People love watching the fish sellers throw fish in the air.
Part six, Coffee Culture Seattle Loves Coffee.
The first Starbucks cafe opened here in 1971.
Many people drink coffee every day.
There are small and cozy cafes on almost every street.
Part seven, Nature Around Seattle.
Seattle is full of nature.
There are lakes, parks, forests and mountains nearby.
People like hiking, camping and boating.
On sunny days, the city looks bright and cheerful.
Part eight, Mount Rainier.
Not far from Seattle, there is a huge mountain called Mount Rainier.
It is covered with snow.
It is one of the most beautiful mountains in the United States.
Many visitors come to see it every year.
Part nine, Technology.
City Seattle is a big technology center.
Many famous companies started here.
For example, Microsoft and Amazon.
Many people work in technology, computers and engineering.
Part 10, Music History.
Seattle has a rich music history.
The city is known for grunge music.
Bands like Nirvana and Pearl Jam started here.
Music is an important part of Seattle's culture.
Part 11, Friendly and Creative People.
People in Seattle are friendly and creative.
Many artists, writers and musicians live here.
People enjoy reading, painting and making new things.
The city is full of ideas and inspiration.
Part 12, Closing Seattle is a city of nature, rain, technology and music.
It is modern, green and full of life.
If you visit the United States, Seattle is a wonderful place to explore.
Thank you for listening to today's episode.
See you in the next one.
